item.title: Lady Raiders move on up in latest AP Top 25

item.title: Red Raiders fall to No. 16 in AP men's basketball poll
item.description: The Texas Tech Red Raiders have moved down three spots to No. 16 in the AP Men's College Basketball Poll after securing a 70-63 victory against West Virginia on the road.

item.title: Fatal crash in Gaines County claims life of Seminole resident
item.description: A crash in Gaines County, Texas resulted in one person dead and one person seriously injured after the driver of Vehicle 1 disregarded a stop sign, causing a collision with Vehicle 2, in which the passenger was not wearing a seatbelt.

item.title: From Seed to Soil: How a fourth-generation Plainview company is driving innovation in agriculture
item.description: As planting season approaches, farmers and ranchers are preparing their fields, but before any crop can grow, the process begins with one essential element, seed.

item.title: Lubbock libraries celebrate National Library Lovers Month
item.description: February is the month of love but for booklovers it is National Library Lovers month. This month-long holiday was created by the Friends and Foundations of California Libraries in 2003, and is celebrated to honor the importance of libraries, librarians and books.

item.title: Pancake House eager to reopen its doors after extensive renovations
item.description: The Pancake House in Lubbock, Texas has completed repairs and is set to reopen on February 18th after being closed since August due to a rainstorm.

item.title: UPDATE: 5 people found dead in Plainview; Texas Rangers investigating
item.description: The Texas Department of Public Safety provided an update on Monday morning regarding the death investigation in the 2700 block of Upchurch Street in Plainview.
